title: The Eleusinian Miseries
author: Mike Russo
description: Well, isn't this a lark! After solid years of going after old Alky to let you in on that Mysteries wheeze of his, at last tonight's the night. He's dragged you from Athens to Eleusis for the to-do, but no sooner had you clapped eyes on the wine and canapés than he informed you of a spot of work in need of doing.  You've heard of work, you're sure you'll be good at it!
